run.name: Fair Isaac Corp
run.title: CP-OS host session (FICO)
run.summary: FICO has strong, cash-generative earnings, but debt-funded buybacks lifted analyst leverage to 4.46x against a covenant maximum of 4.5x that steps down. The credit depends on pricing and on shareholder-return choices. Launched through CP-OS as of 2026-11-05 on the retained context; the EDGAR registrant name in that context is FAIR ISAAC CORP.

revenue.basis: Total revenues, as the CP-1 table prints it.

ebitda.basis: EBITDA (analyst), as the CP-1 table prints it.

leverage.basis: Total debt / EBITDA. Debt at June 30, 2026 (10-Q page:10); LTM to June 30, 2026 from nine-month figures; EBITDA includes no pro forma credit for the June 2026 term loan; not the covenant ratio, whose definition is not supplied

coverage.basis: EBITDA / cash interest. Cash interest LTM US$164.9m (10-Q page:5); lags the new debt; annualised contractual interest is US$316.5m, which gives 3.96x (see Calculations)

cash.basis: Cash. Cash 10-Q page:2, of which US$139.8m held by foreign subsidiaries (10-Q page:33); undrawn is the US$1.0bn revolver less US$710.0m drawn (10-Q page:10, page:11); the term loan was borrowed in full so adds no undrawn amount; derived; letters of credit not disclosed

cashflow.basis: Net cash provided by operating activities, as the CP-1 table prints it.

gaps: Host session: an agent answered every module from the pinned filings and CP-5 is its own review. No independent review has been made. Treat the analysis as candidate.
CP-2 main limitation: The covenant definition and executed financing documents are not supplied, so headroom cannot be measured.
CP-1 main limitation: No company EBITDA or covenant ratio is reported, and the credit agreement definitions are not supplied.
